question_text: A field recorder uses RAM while processing audio and an SSD to retain recordings. State two differences between these storage devices.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: RAM is volatile whereas SSD retains data without power. RAM normally offers lower access latency than SSD.

marking_points.criterion: RAM lower access latency versus SSD slower access.
